// Generator of signed-messages.json, a test of the croessner/dkim2 package. It signs messages with
// the signer of croessner/dkim2 (the keys and helpers of its own tests) and records the verdict of
// its own verifier. To regenerate, copy this file into the root of a croessner/dkim2 checkout as
// zz_interop_export_test.go and run:
//
//   INTEROP_OUT=<directory> go test -run TestInteropExport -count=1 .
//
// The keys are fixed (the RSA key of testdata/vectors/draft-ietf-dkim-dkim2-spec-09 and seeded
// Ed25519 and ML-DSA-44 keys), and only the ML-DSA-44 signatures are randomized (hedged signing), so a new
// run changes those bytes but none of the verdicts.
package dkim2

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/ed25519"
	"crypto/mldsa"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"crypto/x509"
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/croessner/dkim2/internal/routeplan"
)

type exportCase struct {
	Name     string   `json:"name"`
	MailFrom string   `json:"mailFrom"`
	RcptTo   []string `json:"rcptTo"`
	Time     int64    `json:"time"`
	Result   string   `json:"result"`
	Reason   string   `json:"reason"`
	Message  string   `json:"message"`
}

// TestInteropExport writes croessner-signed messages for verification by mailauth
func TestInteropExport(t *testing.T) {
	out := os.Getenv("INTEROP_OUT")
	if out == "" {
		t.Skip("INTEROP_OUT not set")
	}
	rsaKey := loadPublicSigningRSAKey(t)
	edSeed := sha256.Sum256([]byte("interop-ed25519"))
	edKey := ed25519.NewKeyFromSeed(edSeed[:])
	mlSeed := sha256.Sum256([]byte("interop-mldsa44"))
	mlKey, err := mldsa.NewPrivateKey(mldsa.MLDSA44(), mlSeed[:])
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	provider := &publicSigningProvider{rsaKey: rsaKey, edKey: edKey, mlKey: mlKey}
	const now = int64(1_700_000_000)
	facade, err := NewSigner(provider, publicRouteMemoryAuthority{value: routeplan.NewMemoryAuthority()}, &authorizeOrdinary{}, provider,
		WithSigningClock(func() time.Time { return time.Unix(now, 0) }), WithoutSignerSubdomainFromAuthorization())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	handle := func(name string) PrivateKeyHandle { h, _ := NewPrivateKeyHandle([]byte(name)); return h }
	rsaCred, _ := NewRSASigningCredential("rsa", &rsaKey.PublicKey, handle("rsa"))
	edCred, _ := NewEd25519SigningCredential("ed", edKey.Public().(ed25519.PublicKey), handle("ed"))
	mlCred, _ := NewMLDSA44SigningCredential("pq", mlKey.PublicKey(), handle("pq"))
	profile := func(domain string, creds ...SigningCredential) SigningProfile {
		p, err := NewSigningProfile(domain, creds...)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("profile %s: %v", domain, err)
		}
		return p
	}
	fixture := publicSigningFixture{facade: facade, provider: provider}

	alice, bob := []byte("<alice@example.test>"), [][]byte{[]byte("<bob@example.net>")}
	origin := func(raw []byte, p SigningProfile, meta SigningMetadata) []byte {
		res, rec, err := facade.SignOriginator(context.Background(), NewOriginatorSigningRequest(
			raw, alice, bob, fixture.originTicket(t, raw, RouteDisclosureSingle), p, meta, SigningTransportFinalNetworkPreDotStuffing))
		out, ok := res.Unrestricted()
		if err != nil || rec.Valid() || !ok {
			t.Fatalf("SignOriginator: %v", err)
		}
		return out.Bytes()
	}
	existing := func(signed, revised []byte, p SigningProfile, literals RecipeLiteralPolicy) []byte {
		_, capability, err := facade.VerifyForRevision(context.Background(), NewVerifyRequest(signed, alice, bob))
		if err != nil || !capability.Valid() {
			t.Fatalf("VerifyForRevision: %v", err)
		}
		res, rec, err := facade.SignExisting(context.Background(), NewExistingSigningRequest(
			capability, revised, []byte("<relay@example.net>"), [][]byte{[]byte("<carol@next.test>")},
			fixture.existingTicket(t, capability, revised, RouteDisclosureSingle), p, SigningMetadata{},
			SigningTransportFinalNetworkPreDotStuffing, RejectUnavailableBody, literals))
		out, ok := res.Unrestricted()
		if err != nil || rec.Valid() || !ok {
			t.Fatalf("SignExisting: %v", err)
		}
		return out.Bytes()
	}

	raw := []byte("From: Alice <alice@example.test>\r\nTo: bob@example.net\r\nSubject: Interop\r\nDate: Tue, 14 Nov 2023 22:13:20 +0000\r\nMessage-ID: <interop@example.test>\r\n\r\nHello world!\r\n\r\nSecond paragraph.\r\n")
	var cases []exportCase
	verifier, err := NewVerifier(provider, WithVerificationClock(func() time.Time { return time.Unix(now+600, 0) }), WithoutSubdomainFromAuthorization())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	// records the verdict of this library, which must be the expected one
	add := func(name string, msg []byte, mf string, rt []string, expect string) {
		forward := make([][]byte, 0, len(rt))
		for _, rcpt := range rt {
			forward = append(forward, []byte(rcpt))
		}
		result, err := verifier.Verify(context.Background(), NewVerifyRequest(msg, []byte(mf), forward))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("%s: Verify: %v", name, err)
		}
		state := strings.ToLower(string(result.State()))
		if state != expect {
			t.Fatalf("%s: verified as %s (%s), expected %s", name, state, result.PrimaryReason(), expect)
		}
		cases = append(cases, exportCase{name, mf, rt, now + 600, state, string(result.PrimaryReason()), string(msg)})
	}
	toBob := []string{"<bob@example.net>"}
	toCarol := []string{"<carol@next.test>"}

	rsaOnly := origin(raw, profile("example.test", rsaCred), SigningMetadata{})
	add("rsa", rsaOnly, "<alice@example.test>", toBob, "pass")
	add("ed25519", origin(raw, profile("example.test", edCred), SigningMetadata{}), "<alice@example.test>", toBob, "pass")
	add("rsa+ed25519 dual", origin(raw, profile("example.test", rsaCred, edCred), SigningMetadata{}), "<alice@example.test>", toBob, "pass")
	add("mldsa44", origin(raw, profile("example.test", mlCred), SigningMetadata{}), "<alice@example.test>", toBob, "pass")
	add("classical group or mldsa44", origin(raw, profile("example.test", mlCred, edCred, rsaCred), SigningMetadata{}), "<alice@example.test>", toBob, "pass")
	meta, err := NewSigningMetadata([]byte("abc123"), true, []SigningFlag{SigningFlagFeedback})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	add("nonce and feedback flag", origin(raw, profile("example.test", rsaCred), meta), "<alice@example.test>", toBob, "pass")
	add("empty body", origin([]byte("From: alice@example.test\r\nSubject: none\r\n\r\n"), profile("example.test", rsaCred), SigningMetadata{}), "<alice@example.test>", toBob, "pass")

	// forwarder, unchanged
	add("forward unchanged", existing(rsaOnly, rsaOnly, profile("example.net", rsaCred), RecipeCopyOnly), "<relay@example.net>", toCarol, "pass")
	// list style revision: subject tag, new header, footer
	revised := []byte(strings.Replace(string(rsaOnly), "Subject: Interop", "Subject: [list] Interop\r\nList-Id: <list.example.net>", 1) + "--\r\nfooter\r\n")
	appended := []byte(strings.Replace(string(rsaOnly), "Subject: Interop", "Subject: Interop\r\nList-Id: <list.example.net>", 1) + "--\r\nfooter\r\n")
	add("revision copy-only (new header, footer)", existing(rsaOnly, appended, profile("example.net", rsaCred), RecipeCopyOnly), "<relay@example.net>", toCarol, "pass")
	add("revision with literals (subject tag, new header, footer)", existing(rsaOnly, revised, profile("example.net", rsaCred), RecipeAllowLiterals), "<relay@example.net>", toCarol, "pass")
	// body rewritten in the middle, needs a literal
	rewritten := []byte(strings.Replace(string(rsaOnly), "Second paragraph.", "Second paragraph, edited.", 1))
	revisedWithLiterals := existing(rsaOnly, rewritten, profile("example.net", edCred, rsaCred), RecipeAllowLiterals)
	add("body line rewritten, literal Recipe, ed+rsa forwarder", revisedWithLiterals, "<relay@example.net>", toCarol, "pass")

	// failures
	add("body changed", []byte(strings.Replace(string(rsaOnly), "Hello world!", "Hello World!", 1)), "<alice@example.test>", toBob, "fail")
	add("wrong RCPT TO", rsaOnly, "<alice@example.test>", []string{"<eve@example.net>"}, "fail")
	add("revision footer changed", []byte(strings.Replace(string(existing(rsaOnly, revised, profile("example.net", rsaCred), RecipeAllowLiterals)), "footer", "evil", 1)), "<relay@example.net>", toCarol, "fail")

	spki := func(key any) string {
		der, err := x509.MarshalPKIXPublicKey(key)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		return base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(der)
	}
	rsaRecord := "v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=" + spki(&rsaKey.PublicKey)
	dns := map[string][]string{
		"rsa._domainkey.example.test": {rsaRecord},
		"rsa._domainkey.example.net":  {rsaRecord},
		"ed._domainkey.example.test":  {"v=DKIM1; k=ed25519; p=" + base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(edKey.Public().(ed25519.PublicKey))},
		"ed._domainkey.example.net":   {"v=DKIM1; k=ed25519; p=" + base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(edKey.Public().(ed25519.PublicKey))},
		"pq._domainkey.example.test":  {"v=DKIM1; k=mldsa44; p=" + base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(mlKey.PublicKey().Bytes())},
	}
	data, err := json.MarshalIndent(map[string]any{"messages": cases, "dns": dns}, "", "    ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(out+"/signed-messages.json", append(data, '\n'), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
